Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan munches on an apple.]

Rohan: "That's easy."

[Rohan sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Rohan (softly): "I really enjoyed today."
